findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "fetch_page_contents" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: urls, text, highlights, summary, livecrawl, livecrawlTimeout, subpages, subpageTarget, extras, context, maxAgeHours

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "html-to-markdown" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_page_contents, html_to_text · Private data: html_to_text · Public sink: html_to_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_page_contents, html_to_text · Private data: html_to_text · Public sink: html_to_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
